investment_theses.thesis: Margin debt extremes and retail leverage surge into May-June 2026 create >50% probability of a flash-crash liquidation cascade requiring emergency Fed liquidity, favoring long USD and short equities.
supporting_signals: CNBC: margin debt surged to record levels; 29-year-old retail traders borrowing on portfolio collateral
CoinDesk: Bitcoin volatility structure shows extreme swings *more* frequent than 2018 despite lower average volatility
CoinDesk: One-year after 10/10 flash crash, altcoin liquidity still fragile
investment_theses.counter_view: Fed coordination and circuit breakers prevent 2018-scale flash crash; retail leverage is smaller fraction of total equity market cap than 2021.
investment_theses.expression: Short SPY or QQQ calls; long DXY spot or UUP; long BTC/ETH on dip (crisis hedge)

investment_theses.thesis: Microsoft H-1B visa restrictions and Nadella's 'emergency brake' signal a shift from AI capex acceleration to governance moat building; NVDA and chip-supply-focused names face structural capex reallocation.

CNBC: Nadella calls for AI safety safeguards and pacing—implies internal talent/capex friction
CNBC: GPU access fragmentation reduces big-tech moat; smaller players can now access compute
investment_theses.counter_view: NVDA still supply-constrained; neocloud proliferation is long-tail cost reduction, not substitution for enterprise GPU contracts.
investment_theses.expression: Short NVDA relative to SMCI or TSM; long OpenAI/Anthropic (if public) or AI safety-focused equity; neutral to long SPX as capex shifts to software over hardware

investment_theses.thesis: Ledger hardware implant breach and Coldcard phishing compromise signal existential trust crisis in consumer hardware wallets; institutional custody (Coinbase, Kraken) and stablecoin yield will capture AUM inflow.
supporting_signals: Cointelegraph: Ledger confirms unauthorized hardware implant; >$86M in losses disclosed
Cointelegraph: Coldcard investigating phishing link on X; supply-chain attack vector live
CoinDesk: XRP Ledger patched decade-old bug that could create billions in spurious assets—signals underlying protocol fragility
investment_theses.counter_view: Hardware wallet adoption still small relative to exchange custody; Ledger may recover via litigation or insurance; trust in Ledger brand remains high among HODLers.
investment_theses.expression: Long stablecoin yield (USDC, USDT on Compound/Aave); long Coinbase (COIN) as custodian-of-last-resort; short Ledger-dependent token ecosystems (e.g., Monero if physical-custody dependent)

investment_theses.thesis: Post-quantum cryptography adoption (Tron testnet live) signals an 18-36 month window before quantum threat becomes mainstream concern; protocols with PQC roadmaps will command valuation premium.
supporting_signals: Cointelegraph: Justin Sun announces Tron post-quantum cryptography testnet live
CoinDesk: XRP Ledger security patches indicate protocol-level hardening cycle
Hacker News: Decade-old RAM making a comeback—signals recomputation and verification overhead concerns
investment_theses.counter_view: Quantum threat is 10+ years away; PQC adoption imposes performance and complexity costs with no near-term ROI.
investment_theses.expression: Long TRX relative to protocols without PQC roadmap; long Layer-1s with active protocol R&D budget (e.g., Celestia, Starknet); avoid aging monolithic chains

investment_theses.thesis: Stablecoin adoption in APAC by 2031 (Visa survey: nearly 50% of consumers) implies 5-7 year runway for APAC-native stablecoin issuers and remittance-layer tokens; STRK, TIA, and LayerZero benefit from cross-border settlement.
supporting_signals: CoinDesk: Visa survey—nearly half of APAC consumers open to stablecoins by 2031
CoinDesk: Tokenized commodities expanding beyond gold into lending and oil
Crypto trending: Starknet, Celestia, LayerZero in top movers—all enable cross-chain settlement
investment_theses.counter_view: Central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) will preempt private stablecoin adoption in APAC; regulatory barriers in China, India remain insurmountable.
investment_theses.expression: Long STRK, TIA, ZRO relative to BTC; long ETH/BTC ratio (layer-2 and cross-chain infrastructure play); consider APAC-specific stablecoin exposure if tokenized (e.g., Singapore USDC or USDT localized variants)
